notes:
Compress PDF now has a third mode.

Shrink images resizes and re-encodes the pictures inside a PDF while leaving every word selectable — on most documents that is where the space actually is. A 281-page manual goes from 6.7 MB to 4.8 MB with the text untouched.

Smallest file no longer spends ten seconds finding out it cannot help. It measures a few pages first and stops if the result would be larger than the original.

And before you start, the panel now tells you what the file is made of and what each mode will do about it.
